title: BPSC AEDO Recruitment 2026
summary: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released a Notification on its official website for the recruitment of Assistant Education Development Officer (AEDO) posts. This recruitment is for 935 positions. The BPSC application process will start on 01 December 2026 , and candidates were able to submit their applications until 31 December 2026 . The minimum age is 21 Years & the maximum age is 37 – 42 years as on 01 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for the BPSC AEDO Recruitment 2026 provided below. (Advt. No. 16/2026)
qualification: Candidates must have a graduate degree from a recognized university or an equivalent qualification. For complete details, please check the official notification.
